name: Uptimia Free
free_limit: After the 30-day trial, the ongoing free plan includes monitoring of one website and one API endpoint, each checked as frequently as every 5 minutes.
watch_out: The initial 30-day trial exposes paid features; the continuing free plan excludes transaction, page-speed and real-user monitoring. No credit card is required for the trial; commercial-use terms and any free-plan alerting limits need independent confirmation.
